hypothesis: A forward-only estimate revision ledger with same-event identity and PIT flags can unblock later analyst-revision alpha tests without touching production signal logic.
single_causal_variable: forward estimate revision ledger schema and PIT-safe same-event delta construction only

historical_experiment_check.exp-20260507-090: Data audit found high EPS/surprise coverage but no PIT-safe analyst revision history; next action was a forward-only ledger.
historical_experiment_check.exp-20260507-011: Simple earnings_event_long re-enable rejected; this run does not re-enable C or change entry/ranking/sizing.
historical_experiment_check.why_not_duplicate: This is not another C-sleeve or earnings threshold test. It creates the forward data substrate required before testing revision alpha.

implementation.snapshot_schema_change: quant/earnings_snapshot.py now preserves next_earnings_date already produced by get_earnings_data() and reports tickers_with_next_earnings_date coverage.
implementation.run_adapter_amendment: quant/run.py now calls the same default-off ledger helper after the daily earnings snapshot so the operator still only runs python quant/run.py.
implementation.report_amendment: quant/report_generator.py surfaces ledger rows/usable/up/down in the existing non-OHLCV coverage section.
implementation.new_tests: quant/test_estimate_revision_ledger.py plus existing snapshot test update in quant/test_quant.py

shadow_or_replay_metrics.reason: Ledger smoke output has zero usable revision rows because existing snapshots predate the schema addition and lack next_earnings_date. Future snapshots will include the event identity field.

data_availability_pit_status.why_zero_usable_rows: Existing 2026-05-06 snapshot was written before next_earnings_date was added to the persisted schema; same-event revision deltas require at least two forward snapshots with the new field.
data_availability_pit_status.pit_rule: A revision row is usable only when current and prior same-event snapshots were written no later than one UTC calendar day after their as_of_date and share the same next_earnings_date.

decision_rationale: Accept the default-off data harness, not the alpha. It records event identity, PIT safety, and same-event EPS estimate deltas needed for future shadow analysis.
next_minimum_action: After two or more forward snapshots with next_earnings_date exist, run the ledger daily and begin a 30-60 trading-day observation window before testing candidate forward returns or slot value.
